page.content:
New Japan Pro-Wrestling — Strong Style, the G1, and Wrestle Kingdom.

How NJPW connects

  • Character: Antonio Inoki — Antonio Inoki founded New Japan Pro-Wrestling in 1972.
  • Event: G1 Climax — The G1 Climax is New Japan's summer round-robin tournament.
  • Event: Wrestle Kingdom — Wrestle Kingdom is New Japan's January showcase.
  • Character: Hiroshi Tanahashi — Tanahashi was the Ace who later became New Japan's president.
  • Concept: Strong Style — Strong Style is the fighting-spirit identity of New Japan.
  • Work: NJPW World — NJPW World is New Japan's streaming home.
  • Faction: Bushiroad — Bushiroad bought New Japan and funded the Wrestle Kingdom boom.
  • Event: Dominion — Dominion is New Japan's mid-year title card.
  • Faction: Bullet Club — Bullet Club is New Japan's most exported faction.
  • Faction: Los Ingobernables de Japón — LIJ is the destrozando unit that remade New Japan's 2010s.
  • Location: Tokyo Dome — The Tokyo Dome is New Japan's January cathedral.
  • Event: Sakura Genesis — Sakura Genesis is New Japan's spring Ryogoku card.
  • Location: Korakuen Hall — Korakuen Hall still hosts New Japan's small-room cards.

What is NJPW?

New Japan Pro-Wrestling is the Tokyo promotion Antonio Inoki founded in 1972. Its modern lore runs through the IWGP title, the G1 Climax, Wrestle Kingdom at the Tokyo Dome, and factions such as CHAOS, Los Ingobernables de Japón, Bullet Club, and United Empire.

Key threads lead to Antonio Inoki, G1 Climax, Wrestle Kingdom, Hiroshi Tanahashi, Strong Style and NJPW World.
